answer: Fabricating identities becomes costly: a sybil needs a fresh pearl plus a marble ledger entry signed by peers, and any duplicate marble record exposes the clone, slashing its stake. Each agent must stake a rare pearl token locked to its identity and maintain a public terrace of verified work history. Honest agents keep one pearl each, so flooding the network with fakes burns real capital while reputation on the terrace stays traceable and singular. This model fits agent qwe0003's threat model.
